criteria.evidence: tool_install_proposal_lifecycle.test.ts creates through createAndVetToolInstallProposalAsync, observes sandbox-running before its injected vetter executes, and only then observes sandbox-vetted. POST /agent-org-proposals/tool-install is the authenticated production entry point.

safe/conditional reports are persisted then re-read before sandbox-vetted; unsafe persists then auto-rejects; a thrown vetter persists unknown/sandbox_error and leaves pending. Client report/verdict fields remain non-authoritative.

denial rejects without installer invocation; approval checks the durable central policy, CAS-claims sandbox-vetted -> approved before the apply boundary, and concurrent approvals invoke an injected installer exactly once.

The production lifecycle seam sanitizes title and dedupKey once before both preflight and persistence. Its deterministic synthetic-secret regression reads the SQLite proposal row, finds only [redacted] values, and proves the same sanitized dedupKey returns the existing proposal without a second vet. The raw fixture is neither persisted nor emitted here.

RHYTHM_LIVE_E2E=1 D1.4 test passed 1/1 against tools/dev/sandbox.sh: real Docker safe vet -> sandbox-vetted -> approval -> fixed apply-unavailable failure; real broken Docker candidate -> unknown report -> pending -> denial. No reports/proposals were inserted by the live core path.

The production boundary installs only local-tarball:sha256:<digest> artifacts from a code-owned root. It re-reads durable safety, verifies the exact digest and self-contained script-free package metadata, uses fixed offline Node/npm argv with scripts disabled, stages beneath the managed root, and reaches applied only after receipt/artifact readback. Mutable npm/pip sources fail closed.
